record.context_brief: Claw-free graphs and real negative zeros
record.original_question: If G is claw-free (has no induced K_{1,3}), must every zero of the hard-core lattice-gas partition function Z(w) be a negative real number?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.5 (Hamidoune [28], Stanley [66]) If G is claw-free (i.e. has no induced subgraph K1,3), then all the zeros of Z(w) are negative real.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite simple graph. The hard-core lattice-gas partition function (independence polynomial) of $G$ is
$$Z_G(w) \;=\; \sum_{I \subseteq V \text{ independent}} w^{|I|},$$
where the sum is over all independent sets $I$ of $G$ (sets containing no edge of $G$), including the empty set. The graph $K_{1,3}$ (the "claw") is the complete bipartite graph with parts of sizes $1$ and $3$. A graph $G$ is called claw-free if it contains no induced subgraph isomorphic to $K_{1,3}$.

Prove or disprove: for every finite simple claw-free graph $G$, every (complex) zero of $Z_G(w)$ is a negative real number.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture was proved by Maria Chudnovsky and Paul Seymour in "The roots of the independence polynomial of a clawfree graph" (J. Combin. Theory Ser. B, 2007), establishing that the independence polynomial of every claw-free graph has only real roots; since the coefficients are nonnegative, all roots are negative real numbers.

status_evidence.title: The Roots of the Independence Polynomial of a Clawfree Graph (Chudnovsky-Seymour)
status_evidence.snippet: We prove that for every clawfree graph G, all the roots of its independence polynomial are real.
status_evidence.claim: Chudnovsky and Seymour proved the Hamidoune–Stanley conjecture that the independence polynomial of a claw-free graph has only real (and hence negative) roots.

status_evidence.title: The roots of the independence polynomial of a clawfree graph - ScienceDirect
status_evidence.snippet: Published 2007 in Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series B, proving real-rootedness of the independence polynomial for claw-free graphs.
status_evidence.claim: The published Chudnovsky–Seymour theorem resolves the conjecture in the affirmative.
